title: Short iron fly through results on F&O stocks (re-registration of eh-08)
hypothesis: An iron fly sold on an F&O stock at the close before its results and bought back one or two sessions later earns a positive return on margin after charges and slippage.

mechanism.text: Event-risk premium and retail demand for lottery payoffs before results; implied volatility collapses after.

evidence.source: Dubinsky, Johannes, Kaeck and Seeger, Review of Financial Studies 32(2)
evidence.finding: Priced announcement-day jumps in option prices.

evidence.source: Jain, Varma and Agarwalla, Journal of Futures Markets
evidence.finding: Single-stock IV well above realised volatility.

universe.name: fno-stocks-pit
universe.rule: Stocks in the F&O list on the results date whose ATM and wing strikes traded that session.

turnover.basis: a few hundred events a year across the universe; costs about 7-10% of the credit a trade, modelled per trade

prior_trials.basis: eh-08-event-crush, this same registration under its first id, ran all 8 grid points on 2026-11-02 (event-vol engine revision 1) and logged 8 trials, every one with 0 trades in train and in validation: the F&O stock boards before July 2024 carried no underlying price, so no at-the-money iron fly was ever priced (fixed in #88). Its REJECT stays on record and is annotated VOID in annotations.json; its 8 trials are charged here so the deflated Sharpe ratio pays for every look at this rule.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout return on margin above zero after charges over at least 100 events.

kill_criteria: Holdout return on margin at or below zero.
The realised move larger than the implied move on more than half the holdout events.
Fewer than 100 holdout events with traded wings.

prior.reason: A plausible premium, but stock option wings are thin and slippage may take it all.

feasibility.reason: Needs results dates and legacy stock option bhavcopies (#71) and event straddles in the engine (#73).

contamination: eh-08-event-crush ran this exact grid on the train and validation windows (2012-01-02 to 2023-06-30) and produced 0 trades in all 8 trials, because the stock boards it read had no spot (#88). What that void run revealed is that the data was missing; it revealed no returns, no option prices of an iron fly and no gate number about the idea itself (every metric was zero). Its holdout (2023-07-17 to 2026-10-30) stayed sealed and is unseen for this idea: stock option prices for the holdout are unseen, as eh-08 registered.

outcome.why: 8 of 10 validation gates failed: out-of-sample expectancy after charges; out-of-sample profit factor; max drawdown (train + validation, capital); deflated Sharpe ratio; probability of backtest overfitting; survives 1.5x costs; parameter neighbourhood; primary metric on validation (return on margin). The holdout stays sealed.
outcome.chosen_on: train (best primary metric), screened on validation
